description: Looking for an app like Instagram but private, without Reels? Five apps for close friends compared: Katkee, BeReal, Locket, WhatsApp Status and Snapchat.
How to hide your WhatsApp status from one person or everyone on Android and iPhone, what "Only share with" means, and whether they find out.
70 Christmas captions and status lines for Instagram and WhatsApp: short, with family, with friends, funny, Hinglish and for Christmas moments in India.
Katkee is a free Stories app for your own people: Stories with music, an audience you choose for each one, Highlights, chats and video calls.
A beginner's guide to Katkee: sign up, set up your profile, post your first Story with a song, make a Close Friends list, chat and invite friends.
How to make a Close Friends list on Katkee, share Stories only with them, and what your friends can and can't see.
How to create, edit and share Highlights on Katkee, keep your best Stories on your profile, and use your private Archive.
The first 1,000 people on Katkee get a numbered Founding member badge on their profile for good. Here's how to get one.
Bring the most friends to Katkee by 21 December 2026 and win a ₹1,000 Amazon voucher. How the invite contest works, dates and rules.
30 New Year 2027 Story and status ideas, from the countdown to New Year's Day, plus captions in English and Hinglish you can copy.
70 status ideas sorted by mood: everyday, happy, friends, calm, funny and festivals, each with a short caption you can copy.
How to add music to your Story or status on Instagram, WhatsApp and Katkee, and how to pick the part of the song that fits.
40 ideas for Stories only your inner circle sees: honest everyday moments, inside jokes, questions and feelings, with tips.
Four ways to share Stories and status only with close friends: Instagram Close Friends, WhatsApp, Snapchat and Katkee compared.
Who can see your status and Stories on WhatsApp, Instagram and Katkee, how to change it, and five habits that keep you private.
